item.title: Bungie stands firm on Marathon aesthetic, while the 'fontslop' debate rages on
item.description: Following the Marathon Server Slam, feedback is flowing wide and free across the internet. One of the more prominent areas of discussion is focused on the game's readability: how easy it is to digest information you're given on one of its various menus. Or, as its been so succinctly dubbed by some: 'Fontslop'. Read more

item.title: Bungie lays out the plan for Marathon seasons: updates will be free for everyone, and the game will feel "meaningfully different" as seasons progress
item.description: Bungie has released new information about the seasonal format of Marathon, as it nears its 5th March release date. These seasons, free to all players and roughly three months long, will result in the game feeling "meaningfully different", according to today's press blast. The game retails for $39.99 / €39.99 / £34.99 for the base edition, so I'm quite glad to hear that the Seasonal updates - for now, at least - aren't going to require added purchases. Read more

item.title: Just like PlayStation, Microsoft has filed a patent for an AI helper that'll play games for you
item.description: Following the discovery of a Sony patent application for an AI PlayStation game assistant earlier this year, a similarly themed patent filing has been spotted from Microsoft, this time concerning an AI helper that can temporarily take over an Xbox session and play a game for you.
